title: build(deps): bump happy-dom from 20.11.6 to 20.14.0
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. happy-dom 20.11.6 -> 20.14.0 in packages/client (devDependency). Test-environment DOM used by vitest (vitest.config.ts sets environment: happy-dom). Affects test execution only; it is not shipped in the client bundle. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: none. Lockfile audited against merge-base d59de10f by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly 1 entry changed version: happy-dom 20.11.6 -> 20.14.0. Zero packages added, zero removed, and no entry outside happy-dom touched. This is the check PR #296 failed -- a bump whose title named one package while the lockfile moved another -- so it was run as an enumeration rather than an eyeball.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for happy-dom from ^20.11.6 to ^20.14.0 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves it: happy-dom 20.11.6 -> 20.14.0. No incidental version movement; the added, removed and non-happy-dom changed sets are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff, and several manifests written for other dependency work would each have covered these two files -- borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.

commands_run: lockfile audit (enumeration, not diff-reading) vs merge-base d59de10f: entries 412 -> 412, version-changed=1 (happy-dom 20.11.6 -> 20.14.0), added=0, removed=0, non-happy-dom touched = NONE
CI is the only build/test verification for this bump
